keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 10 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 40 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

news.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
news.summary: OpenAI described its approach to detecting and disrupting adversarial distillation, combining adversarial testing, model training, classifiers and API-level protections, with particular focus on preventing extraction of chain-of-thought reasoning. In an internal adaptive evaluation with automated red-teaming, the average attack success rate on recovering protected reasoning fell from 54.0% against GPT-6 Astra with original safeguards to 0.2% against GPT-6.2 Astra with updated safeguards, which were also applied to GPT-6.2 Sol.

news.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
news.summary: Hebbia tested a prerelease build of GPT-6 Astra in August-September 2026 on financial research cases covering source citation and presentation building, using the same cases and expert-audited grading criteria for each model. GPT-6 Astra led the best alternative tested by 13.6 percentage points on citing required source types, had 99.5% of cited excerpts rated relevant, met 97.9% of applicable presentation requirements and led by 14.4 percentage points on that measure.

news.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
news.summary: OpenAI introduced MedChemBench, a benchmark of 99 problems drawn from 117 papers and patents containing 761 distinct molecular structures, grading molecular structure reconstruction, scientific reasoning, compound ranking and selection, and property prediction. At the xhigh reasoning setting GPT-6.2 Astra earned 84.5% of available credit, versus 83.3% for GPT-6 Astra, 82.0% for GPT-6.1 Sol and 58.2% for GPT-5.6 Sol, with GPT-6 Astra weakest on selecting compounds and predicting numerical properties.

news.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
news.summary: OpenAI described the Performance Factory, a cloud system in which Codex agents run workflows that investigate performance regressions, propose fixes for engineer review and verify recovery after deployment. Its first Regression Workflow tracked more than 1,700 investigations and root caused over 600 cases in just over three months, or 17 automated investigations per day.

news.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
news.summary: Google DeepMind introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model priced at $3 per million input tokens ($0.15 per million cached) and $15 per million output tokens with a 1 million-token context window. It scores 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at xhigh thinking level, 70.9% on the Vals Index (#2), #1 on Legal Research Bench and Tax Agent Bench, 65.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.1, 58.6 on the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, and rolls out in the Gemini API, AI Studio, Gemini for business, and Google Antigravity.

news.title: Genie 4 is now available
news.summary: Google DeepMind rolled out Genie 4 to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers in Project Genie, adding real-time text-prompt editing of environments, native audio, a creative agent, and a community gallery. Genie 3 was also updated with sessions up to 3 minutes per generation (up from 60 seconds), world chaining, and 360-degree panorama grounding.

news.title: How Google Duplex evolved to also call businesses for you in Gemini
news.summary: Google launched Duplex in Tasks in Gemini, letting the assistant place phone calls to businesses on a user's behalf, and described three generations of architecture moving from closed-domain recurrent models to a unified Gemini-based stack. The post cites business information from Duplex calls shown in Search and Maps over one trillion times as of 2023, and Pixel Call Assist features rolled out from 2019 across five consecutive Pixel generations.

news.title: A game you cannot win unless you have a quantum computer
news.summary: Google Quantum AI reported in a Science paper that it demonstrated measurement contextuality on its superconducting Willow processor, winning the magic square game 98.3% of the time and beating classical strategies on tasks spanning up to 105 qubits. The authors argue these contextuality tasks serve as a benchmark that catches subtle hardware errors that random-circuit tests miss.

news.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
news.summary: Google launched Tool Retrieval in preview in the Gemini Interactions API, letting agents load tool parameter schemas on demand by adding a tool_search tool and setting defer_loading to true, rather than sending the full tool library in each prompt. It works with Gemini 3.6 and later, runs search server-side with no index to host, supports prefix caching and remote MCP servers, and offers a client-side mode with "execution": "client" that adds one round trip per search.

news.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
news.summary: Google's Dialogues on Technology and Society podcast released an episode in which Kent Walker speaks with biographer and historian Walter Isaacson about curiosity and human judgment in the AI era, framed around da Vinci, Franklin and Lovelace. No technical specifics are given beyond the episode's availability.

news.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
news.summary: Google made the Gemini app available on eligible Android (Go edition) lower-memory devices, re-architecting the app so the core experience runs on hardware with less memory. Features include Gemini Live conversation in more than 45 languages, camera-based translation, and Nano Banana image creation, with preloading planned on upcoming devices from partners such as Transsion.

news.title: Put Gemini to work for you
news.summary: Google announced that Gemini can handle tasks such as scheduling appointments, analyzing utility bills, and purchasing items by connecting to email, calendar, and payment methods in hardware-isolated virtual machines. The update rolls out free using the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model across the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India, with advanced features starting in the U.S.; examples include calling two dealerships and booking an appointment in under five minutes and analyzing a $389 electric bill.

news.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
news.summary: Anthropic announced the closing of its IPO of 1,127,000,000 Class A shares at $83.00 per share, including full exercise of the underwriters' option for 147,000,000 shares, with 1,103,351,354 shares sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by selling stockholders. Gross proceeds were approximately $93.5 billion, of which about $91.6 billion went to Anthropic; a concurrent private placement of 313,253,007 Class N shares at $83.00 to AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, NVIDIA and TSMC Partners raised approximately $26.0 billion, for combined gross proceeds of approximately $119.5 billion.

news.title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
news.summary: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83.00 per share for 980,000,000 Class A shares, of which 956,351,354 are sold by Anthropic and 23,648,646 by selling stockholders, and granted underwriters a 30-day option for up to 147,000,000 additional shares. Trading on Nasdaq under "ANT" was expected to begin November 19, 2026, with the offering expected to close November 20, 2026.

news.title: Can AI help build a healthier future?
news.summary: A Microsoft Research podcast episode of The Shape of Things to Come features Doug Burger with Ava Amini, Eric Horvitz, and Eric Topol discussing AI-assisted medical diagnosis, medical imaging, whole-patient models, virtual cells, and biological foundation models. It also covers why promising research is slow to reach patients, AI-guided experiments and drug discovery, and the need for better biological data and real-world validation.

news.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
news.summary: Microsoft Research, UC Berkeley and Microsoft Security released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from an agent's past sessions in a repository to cut token costs without modifying the agent or model. Across 277 real bug-fixing tasks it reduced costs by 18.4–30.9% across multiple coding agents, with costs falling in every repository tested and task success rates broadly stable; profiling Claude Code on 60 SWE-Bench tasks found 30% of tool calls repeated earlier work after five completed tasks, 16 of 23 tool descriptions never called, and the 17% of failed tasks accounting for 32% of spending.

news.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
news.summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft announced at Ignite expanded Azure access to NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, availability of NVIDIA open models and customization via Microsoft Foundry, and edge AI options, with Microsoft using NVIDIA Dynamo and RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Bing models. Cited results include Azure scaling to 10,240 NVIDIA GPUs with GB200 NVL72 on DeepSeek-V3 in MLPerf Training v6.1, a lead of over 10% on DeepSeek-R1 interactive throughput for GB300 NVL72 in MLPerf Inference v6.1, and EY reporting a 55% accuracy gain and 15x lower cost using Programmed Training with Nemotron models.

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described developer projects combining frontier models with Omniverse libraries, including Falkor's Surface platform using GPT-6 Astra and RTX PRO 6000 Server Edition GPUs on Azure to build facility-scale digital twins, and an Isaac Sim pick-and-place simulation assembled by an agent using GPT-6 Sol. A community developer directed GPT-6 Astra and Claude Code (about eight hours of agent work over a weekend) to build a voice-controlled VR application on an RTX 6000 Ada workstation and Meta Quest 3.

news.title: Season’s Streamings and Savings: Black Friday Deals Come to GeForce NOW
news.summary: GeForce NOW announced Black Friday promotions: 30% off the first six months of new Performance or Ultimate memberships through Nov. 30, and 90% off the first month via Amazon through Dec. 31 on supported Fire TV devices. The service expands to Fire TV Stick HD, 4K Select and 4K (2026 model) on Vega OS, adds streaming up to 5K or 360 fps with DLSS 5, and adds nine games this week including five Bethesda titles with GOG support.

news.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Compact Desktops Out Now
Reducing Rollout Bottlenecks in Reinforcement Learning with NVIDIA Dynamo
news.summary: NVIDIA described how Dynamo serves as a rollout layer for reinforcement learning training, using KV-aware routing to balance cache reuse against worker load, ModelExpress to distribute compressed delta weight updates, and recovery mechanisms that reroute requests and let replacement workers catch up from checkpoints. It lists open-source integrations with verl, NeMo RL, Slime and prime-rl.

news.title: Enabling Real-Time AI for Scientific Instruments with GPU-Native Data Acquisition
news.summary: NVIDIA detailed DAQIRI, a Holoscan data acquisition library that receives detector packets directly into GPU memory, used with a high-dynamic-range electron microscopy camera at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory that produces over 500 Gbps, described as over 500x faster than conventional EELS data streams. The latest release adds hardware packet reordering on ConnectX-7 or newer NICs, an ibverbs engine that nearly doubles per-core throughput at small packet sizes, and a direct polling mode with 2-4 µs send-to-receive latency.

news.title: Build Tool-Calling Parsers in Rust with AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA introduced frontend-crates, reusable Rust components that parse tool calls from LLM output into structured events, with documented recovery rules for malformed, incomplete and streaming inputs. A shared Conformance Corpus pairs model-specific inputs with expected GOLDEN outputs, enabling UNIFIED.* test cases to be reused across model families including Beam, GPT-OSS, Muse Spark and NVIDIA Nemotron 3, with an example using the dynamo-parsers-v2 crate.

news.title: Build Training-Ready Physical AI Datasets with Two Prompts in NVIDIA Cosmos
news.summary: NVIDIA described the Cosmos Data Factory, comprising five cloud-native blueprints and six composable skills orchestrated by an agent so datasets can be built with two prompts. NVIDIA reports up to 60x faster dataset assembly and 45x cheaper autonomous vehicle scenario generation versus traditional methods, measured on a cloud server with eight NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs.

news.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
news.summary: Hugging Face highlighted Inkling 2 Mini from Thinking Machines Lab, a multimodal mixture-of-experts looped transformer with about 26B total and 3B active parameters, 24 decoder layers of which 12 middle layers run three times for 48 logical layer visits, a 1M-token context, 128 experts per layer with 8 selected, and NVFP4/MXFP8 expert weights plus a DSpark drafter. A research variant trained to accept a variable number of loop passes was also released; the post describes vibe tests as at least comparable with Qwen 3.8 27B but calls for more validation.

news.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
news.summary: Hugging Face introduced harness adapters, RL-trained LoRA adapters for Qwen3.8-27B trained inside the target agent harness, reporting that a pi-harness score of 39% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 at 2.9K tokens per task rose to 55% pass@1 at 1.5K tokens with an adapter. Adapters were trained for Pi 1.5.2, OpenCode 2.2.7 and Hermes Agent v0.22.6, and merged into a single super adapter that runs unchanged under all three.

news.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
news.summary: RadixArk released DaisyRose-27B, built on Qwen3.8-27B and trained with reinforcement learning in Miles on long-horizon agent tasks of up to 1M tokens, using 1,200 curated tasks over 18 days on 144 H200 GPUs. Terminal-Bench 4.1 pass@1 rose from 5.6% to 12.0%, with checkpoints released under Apache 2.0 in BF16, FP8 and NVFP4 and the model retaining a 256K-token context window.

news.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
news.summary: A Hugging Face post previews a paper on predicting end-to-end fine-tuning time, using 272 production supervised fine-tuning jobs totaling about 7,382 GPU-hours on NVIDIA H200 GPUs. A FLOP-based estimate reached R² = 0.31 with 12.41 h MAE, while a CatBoost regressor using only pre-dispatch information reached R² = 0.98 with 1.71 h mean absolute error and 0.51 h median error in 5-fold cross-validation.

news.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
news.summary: Apple presented Depth Pro 2, a single scalable network that predicts dense metric depth in meters for images, video and live camera feeds at native resolution, aimed at removing the trade-off between temporal consistency and boundary sharpness. The authors report it outperforms prior work on metric accuracy, sharpness and temporal consistency, and release a family of models plus code and weights.

news.title: Split-and-Scale Latent 3D Representations
news.summary: Apple researchers described split-and-scale, an inference-time method that applies a single pretrained 3D tokenizer to arbitrarily small sub-regions of a scene so the same latent capacity covers a smaller spatial extent, expanding detail without raising training cost. They report reconstruction quality competitive with much larger models that exceed single-GPU memory limits, and train an autoregressive 3D generator that performs competitively with state-of-the-art baselines.

news.title: Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod launched managed cluster extensions for observability and user management, extending to software on running nodes the declarative management applied during 2026 to five cluster configuration layers such as API-driven Slurm configuration, AMI-based configuration, continuous provisioning, topology management and deep health checks. Users retain full access to every node including the controller, and partition-level tree or block topology is supported on Slurm 25.11 or later.

news.title: Introducing Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway: One endpoint across Regions and clusters
news.summary: SageMaker HyperPod introduced the Global Inference Gateway, a single SageMaker-managed endpoint that routes requests across registered clusters in one or multiple Regions, with automatic failover, SigV4 and IAM authentication and AWS PrivateLink, while the per-cluster Inference Gateway continues pod-level placement. AWS illustrates the need with a team serving four models across five clusters in two Regions, which otherwise tracks 20 endpoints; Bagelcode reported beta tests routing across two AWS Regions through a single endpoint with failover when one cluster could not serve the model.

news.title: How Standard Bank Group automates AI risk assessment for generative AI
news.summary: Standard Bank Group, with AWS Professional Services, deployed an automated assessment that scores each generative AI use case against international AI standards and bank policies, producing reports and a dashboard for the existing risk committee approval gates. The pipeline runs in the bank's AWS account with Amazon S3 storage, AWS Well-Architected Tool intake, Step Functions orchestration and a Bedrock foundation model used as an LLM-as-a-judge across four steps, motivated in part by models and tooling changing every three to six months.

news.title: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents
news.summary: Amazon announced general availability of Amazon Textract Insights, a generative AI feature in which users describe fields in natural language via a JSON Schema blueprint with per-field inference types, submit a document or mixed packet, and receive values with confidence scores and page-level grounding without model training. It splits packets and matches sub-documents to blueprints, accepting a single file of up to 3,000 pages from an S3 bucket, with an example of a 26-page mortgage application PDF.

en.editorial: This week’s 1,915 papers, down from 3,212 the previous week, ranged from 349 to 483 per day. Agentic and embodied work stood out: read Gamer for a generalist vision-language-action game agent, and TuringSpace, where fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B lifts success from 1.6% to 33.1% on spatial CAPTCHAs. Weight-Space Programming Doesn’t Need Transformers challenges architectural assumptions. Efficient inference and hardware remain active, with AscendGYM for NPU kernels and Self-Improvement Memory tackling continual recursive self-improvement. Security, privacy, and safety rose from 7.16 to 14.1 per 1k papers, and agent memory from 9.96 to 14.1. Medical AI remains the largest theme at 154 papers. Among releases, Gemini 4 Neon at $3 per million input tokens and $15 output, and TokenEconomizer cutting coding-agent costs 18.4–30.9% across 277 tasks, are worth reading.

news.title: Combatting adversarial distillation
news.summary: OpenAI 描述了其检测和干扰对抗性蒸馏的方法，结合对抗性测试、模型训练、分类器和 API 级保护，特别关注防止思维链推理被提取。在使用自动化红队进行的内部自适应评估中，恢复受保护推理的平均攻击成功率从针对具有原始保护措施的 GPT-6 Astra 的54.0%下降到针对具有更新保护措施的 GPT-6.2 Astra 的0.2%，这些更新措施也应用于 GPT-6.2 Sol。

news.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
news.summary: Hebbia 在 August-September 2026 于金融研究案例上测试了 GPT-6 Astra 的预发布版本，案例涵盖来源引用和演示构建，每个模型使用相同的案例和专家审计的评分标准。在引用所需来源类型方面，GPT-6 Astra 比测试的最佳替代模型领先13.6 percentage points，99.5%的引用摘录被评为相关，满足97.9%的适用演示要求，并在该指标上领先14.4 percentage points。

news.title: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
news.summary: OpenAI 推出了 MedChemBench，一个包含99个问题的基准，这些问题来自117篇论文和专利，包含761个不同的分子结构，评估分子结构重建、科学推理、化合物排序和选择以及性质预测。在 xhigh 推理设置下，GPT-6.2 Astra 获得了84.5%的可用分数，相比之下 GPT-6 Astra 为83.3%，GPT-6.1 Sol 为82.0%，GPT-5.6 Sol 为58.2%，其中 GPT-6 Astra 在选择化合物和预测数值性质方面最弱。

news.title: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
news.summary: OpenAI described the Performance Factory, a cloud system in which Codex agents run workflows that investigate performance regressions, propose fixes for engineer review and verify recovery after deployment. Its first Regression Workflow tracked more than 1,700 investigations and root caused over 600 cases in just over three months, or 17 automated investigations per day.

news.title: Introducing Gemini 4 Neon
news.summary: Google DeepMind 推出了 Gemini 4 Neon，一款定价为 $3 per million input tokens（缓存 $0.15 per million）和 $15 per million output tokens 的模型，上下文窗口为1 million-token。它在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 上得分为61（xhigh 思考级别），在 Vals Index 上得分为70.9%（#2），在 Legal Research Bench 和 Tax Agent Bench 上排名#1，在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 上得分为65.2%，在 Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index 上得分为58.6，并在 Gemini API、AI Studio、Gemini for business 和 Google Antigravity 中推出。

news.title: Genie 4 is now available
news.summary: Google DeepMind 向符合条件的 Project Genie 中的 Google AI Ultra 订阅者推出了 Genie 4，新增实时文本提示编辑环境、原生音频、创意智能体和社区画廊。Genie 3 也进行了更新，每代会话时间最长可达3分钟（此前为60秒），支持世界链和360度全景 grounding。

news.title: How Google Duplex evolved to also call businesses for you in Gemini
news.summary: Google launched Duplex in Tasks in Gemini, letting the assistant place phone calls to businesses on a user's behalf, and described three generations of architecture moving from closed-domain recurrent models to a unified Gemini-based stack. The post cites business information from Duplex calls shown in Search and Maps over one trillion times as of 2023, and Pixel Call Assist features rolled out from 2019 across five consecutive Pixel generations.

news.title: A game you cannot win unless you have a quantum computer
news.summary: Google Quantum AI 在一篇 Science 论文中报告，其超导 Willow 处理器上演示了测量上下文性，在魔术方格游戏中获胜98.3%的时间，并在覆盖高达105 qubits 的任务上击败了经典策略。作者认为这些上下文性任务可作为基准，捕捉随机电路测试遗漏的细微硬件错误。

news.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
news.summary: Google launched Tool Retrieval in preview in the Gemini Interactions API, letting agents load tool parameter schemas on demand by adding a tool_search tool and setting defer_loading to true, rather than sending the full tool library in each prompt. It works with Gemini 3.6 and later, runs search server-side with no index to host, supports prefix caching and remote MCP servers, and offers a client-side mode with "execution": "client" that adds one round trip per search.

news.title: Walter Isaacson on curiosity and creativity in the AI age.
news.summary: Google 的 Dialogues on Technology and Society 播客发布了一集，Kent Walker 与传记作家和历史学家 Walter Isaacson 围绕达·芬奇、富兰克林和洛夫莱斯讨论了 AI 时代的好奇心和人类判断。除该集已上线外，没有给出技术细节。

news.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
news.summary: Google 使 Gemini 应用在符合条件的低内存 Android (Go edition) 设备上可用，重新设计了应用架构，使核心体验在内存较少的硬件上运行。功能包括超过45种语言的 Gemini Live 对话、基于相机的翻译和 Nano Banana 图像创作，并计划在 Transsion 等合作伙伴即将推出的设备上预装。

news.title: Put Gemini to work for you
news.summary: Google announced that Gemini can handle tasks such as scheduling appointments, analyzing utility bills, and purchasing items by connecting to email, calendar, and payment methods in hardware-isolated virtual machines. The update rolls out free using the Gemini 4 Hydrogen model across the U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia, and India, with advanced features starting in the U.S.; examples include calling two dealerships and booking an appointment in under five minutes and analyzing a $389 electric bill.

news.title: Anthropic announces closing of initial public offering, including full exercise of underwriters’ option to purchase additional shares, and closing of concurrent private placement
news.summary: Anthropic 宣布完成其首次公开募股，发行1,127,000,000 Class A shares，每股 $83.00，包括全额行使承销商购买147,000,000 shares 的超额配股权，其中1,103,351,354 shares 由 Anthropic 出售，23,648,646 shares 由售股股东出售。总收益约为 $93.5 billion，其中约 $91.6 billion 归属 Anthropic；同时向 AMD、Broadcom、Google、Micron、Microsoft、NVIDIA 和 TSMC Partners 以每股 $83.00 定向增发313,253,007 Class N shares，筹集约 $26.0 billion，合计总收益约为 $119.5 billion。

news.title: Anthropic prices initial public offering
news.summary: Anthropic 将首次公开募股定价为每股 $83.00，发行980,000,000 Class A shares，其中956,351,354 shares 由 Anthropic 出售，23,648,646 shares 由售股股东出售，并授予承销商30-day option，可额外购买最多147,000,000 shares。交易在 Nasdaq 以 "ANT" 代码进行，预计于 November 19, 2026 开始，发行预计于 November 20, 2026 结束。

news.title: Can AI help build a healthier future?
news.summary: Microsoft Research 的播客《The Shape of Things to Come》的一集邀请了 Doug Burger 与 Ava Amini、Eric Horvitz 和 Eric Topol，讨论 AI 辅助医疗诊断、医学成像、全患者模型、虚拟细胞和生物基础模型。该集还涵盖为何有前景的研究难以惠及患者、AI 引导的实验和药物发现，以及对更好的生物数据和真实世界验证的需求。

news.title: TokenEconomizer: Learning from Experience to Make AI Coding Agents More Efficient
news.summary: Microsoft Research, UC Berkeley and Microsoft Security released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from an agent's past sessions in a repository to cut token costs without modifying the agent or model. Across 277 real bug-fixing tasks it reduced costs by 18.4–30.9% across multiple coding agents, with costs falling in every repository tested and task success rates broadly stable; profiling Claude Code on 60 SWE-Bench tasks found 30% of tool calls repeated earlier work after five completed tasks, 16 of 23 tool descriptions never called, and the 17% of failed tasks accounting for 32% of spending.

news.title: NVIDIA and Microsoft Expand Accelerated Computing From Azure to Windows PCs
news.summary: NVIDIA 和 Microsoft 在 Ignite 上宣布扩大 Azure 对 NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 系统的访问，通过 Microsoft Foundry 提供 NVIDIA 开放模型和定制化，以及边缘 AI 选项，Microsoft 使用 NVIDIA Dynamo 和 RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU 用于 Bing 模型。引用的结果包括 Azure 在 MLPerf Training v6.1 中使用 GB200 NVL72 扩展到10,240个 NVIDIA GPU 运行 DeepSeek-V3，在 MLPerf Inference v6.1 中 GB300 NVL72 在 DeepSeek-R1 交互吞吐量上领先超过10%，以及 EY 报告使用 Programmed Training 配合 Nemotron 模型获得55%的准确率提升和15x更低的成本。

news.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA described developer projects combining frontier models with Omniverse libraries, including Falkor's Surface platform using GPT-6 Astra and RTX PRO 6000 Server Edition GPUs on Azure to build facility-scale digital twins, and an Isaac Sim pick-and-place simulation assembled by an agent using GPT-6 Sol. A community developer directed GPT-6 Astra and Claude Code (about eight hours of agent work over a weekend) to build a voice-controlled VR application on an RTX 6000 Ada workstation and Meta Quest 3.

news.title: Season’s Streamings and Savings: Black Friday Deals Come to GeForce NOW
news.summary: GeForce NOW announced Black Friday promotions: 30% off the first six months of new Performance or Ultimate memberships through Nov. 30, and 90% off the first month via Amazon through Dec. 31 on supported Fire TV devices. The service expands to Fire TV Stick HD, 4K Select and 4K (2026 model) on Vega OS, adds streaming up to 5K or 360 fps with DLSS 5, and adds nine games this week including five Bethesda titles with GOG support.

news.title: NVIDIA RTX Spark Compact Desktops Out Now
Reducing Rollout Bottlenecks in Reinforcement Learning with NVIDIA Dynamo
news.summary: NVIDIA 描述了 Dynamo 如何作为强化学习训练的 rollout 层，使用 KV-aware 路由在缓存重用和工作负载之间取得平衡，使用 ModelExpress 分发压缩的 delta 权重更新，以及恢复机制重新路由请求并让替代工作节点从检查点追赶。文中列出了与 verl、NeMo RL、Slime 和 prime-rl 的开源集成。

news.title: Enabling Real-Time AI for Scientific Instruments with GPU-Native Data Acquisition
news.summary: NVIDIA 详细介绍了 DAQIRI，一个 Holoscan 数据采集库，将探测器数据包直接接收到 GPU 内存中，该库与劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室的一台高动态范围电子显微镜相机配合使用，该相机产生超过500 Gbps 的数据，描述为比传统 EELS 数据流快超过500x。最新版本在 ConnectX-7 或更新的 NIC 上增加了硬件数据包重排序，一个 ibverbs 引擎在小数据包大小下几乎将每核吞吐量翻倍，以及一个直接轮询模式，具有2-4 µs 的发送到接收延迟。

news.title: Build Tool-Calling Parsers in Rust with AI Agents
news.summary: NVIDIA 推出了 frontend-crates，可复用的 Rust 组件，将 LLM 输出中的工具调用解析为结构化事件，并记录了针对格式错误、不完整和流式输入的恢复规则。一个共享的 Conformance Corpus 将特定模型的输入与预期的 GOLDEN 输出配对，使 UNIFIED.* 测试用例能够在包括 Beam、GPT-OSS、Muse Spark 和 NVIDIA Nemotron 3 在内的模型系列中复用，并提供了使用 dynamo-parsers-v2 crate 的示例。

news.title: Build Training-Ready Physical AI Datasets with Two Prompts in NVIDIA Cosmos
news.summary: NVIDIA described the Cosmos Data Factory, comprising five cloud-native blueprints and six composable skills orchestrated by an agent so datasets can be built with two prompts. NVIDIA reports up to 60x faster dataset assembly and 45x cheaper autonomous vehicle scenario generation versus traditional methods, measured on a cloud server with eight NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs.

news.title: Welcome Inkling 2 Mini, Cutting-edge Performance for your Local Setup
news.summary: Hugging Face 重点介绍了 Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 2 Mini，这是一个多模态混合专家循环 Transformer，总参数约26B，活跃参数3B，24个解码器层中12个中间层运行3次，相当于48次逻辑层访问，上下文长度为1M-token，每层128个专家，选择8个，专家权重采用 NVFP4/MXFP8，并配有 DSpark drafter。还发布了一个研究变体，训练为接受可变次数的循环遍数；文章将 vibe 测试描述为至少与 Qwen 3.8 27B 相当，但呼吁进行更多验证。

news.title: Introducing harness adapters: adapt your favorite model to your harness to improve performance and cost
news.summary: Hugging Face 推出了 harness adapters，即针对 Qwen3.8-27B 的 RL 训练 LoRA adapters，在目标智能体 harness 内训练，报告称在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上每个任务2.9K tokens 时 pi-harness 分数为39%，使用 adapter 后在1.5K tokens 下 pass@1 提升至55%。为 Pi 1.5.2、OpenCode 2.2.7 和 Hermes Agent v0.22.6 训练了 adapters，并合并成一个单一的 super adapter，在三个环境下均可不变运行。

news.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
news.summary: RadixArk 发布了 DaisyRose-27B，基于 Qwen3.8-27B 构建，并在 Miles 中使用强化学习在长达1M tokens 的长期智能体任务上训练，使用了1,200个精选任务，在144个 H200 GPU 上训练了18天。Terminal-Bench 4.1 的 pass@1 从5.6%提高到12.0%，检查点以 Apache 2.0 许可证发布，格式包括 BF16、FP8 和 NVFP4，模型保留了256K-token 上下文窗口。

news.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
news.summary: Hugging Face 的一篇文章预览了一篇关于预测端到端微调时间的论文，使用了272个生产监督微调任务，总计约7,382 GPU-hours，运行于 NVIDIA H200 GPU。基于 FLOP 的估计达到 R² = 0.31，MAE 为12.41 h，而仅使用预调度信息的 CatBoost 回归器达到 R² = 0.98，平均绝对误差为1.71 h，中位误差为0.51 h，在5-fold cross-validation 中。

news.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
news.summary: Apple 展示了 Depth Pro 2，一个单一的可扩展网络，以原生分辨率预测图像、视频和实时摄像头输入的稠密公制深度（以 meters 为单位），旨在消除时间一致性和边缘清晰度之间的权衡。作者报告它在公制精度、清晰度和时间一致性上优于先前工作，并发布了一系列模型以及代码和权重。

news.title: Split-and-Scale Latent 3D Representations
news.summary: Apple 研究人员描述了 split-and-scale，一种推理时方法，将单个预训练的 3D tokenizer 应用于场景中任意小的子区域，使得相同的潜在容量覆盖更小的空间范围，在不增加训练成本的情况下扩展细节。他们报告重建质量与远大于单 GPU 内存限制的模型相当，并训练了一个自回归 3D 生成器，其性能与最先进基线相当。

news.title: Introducing managed cluster extensions for observability and user management in Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Slurm
news.summary: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod 推出了用于可观测性和用户管理的托管集群扩展，将2026年应用于五个集群配置层（如 API 驱动的 Slurm 配置、基于 AMI 的配置、持续供应、拓扑管理和深度健康检查）的声明式管理扩展到运行节点上的软件。用户保留对每个节点（包括控制器）的完全访问权限，并在 Slurm 25.11 或更高版本上支持分区级树或块拓扑。

news.title: Introducing Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Global Inference Gateway: One endpoint across Regions and clusters
news.summary: SageMaker HyperPod introduced the Global Inference Gateway, a single SageMaker-managed endpoint that routes requests across registered clusters in one or multiple Regions, with automatic failover, SigV4 and IAM authentication and AWS PrivateLink, while the per-cluster Inference Gateway continues pod-level placement. AWS illustrates the need with a team serving four models across five clusters in two Regions, which otherwise tracks 20 endpoints; Bagelcode reported beta tests routing across two AWS Regions through a single endpoint with failover when one cluster could not serve the model.

news.title: How Standard Bank Group automates AI risk assessment for generative AI
news.summary: Standard Bank Group, with AWS Professional Services, deployed an automated assessment that scores each generative AI use case against international AI standards and bank policies, producing reports and a dashboard for the existing risk committee approval gates. The pipeline runs in the bank's AWS account with Amazon S3 storage, AWS Well-Architected Tool intake, Step Functions orchestration and a Bedrock foundation model used as an LLM-as-a-judge across four steps, motivated in part by models and tooling changing every three to six months.

news.title: Announcing Amazon Textract Insights: Verifiable generative AI for documents
news.summary: Amazon 宣布 Amazon Textract Insights 正式可用，这是一个生成式 AI 功能，用户通过 JSON Schema 蓝图以自然语言描述字段并指定每个字段的推理类型，提交文档或混合数据包，即可获得带有置信度分数和页面级定位的值，无需模型训练。它会拆分数据包并将子文档匹配到蓝图，接受来自 S3 存储桶的单个文件，最多3,000页，并给出了一个26页抵押贷款申请 PDF 的示例。
